segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: The following is a conversation with Javier Malé,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: the president of Argentina.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: He is a libertarian, anarcho-capitalist and economist

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: who campaigned with a chainsaw

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: that symbolized his promise

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: to slash the corrupt bureaucracy of the state.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: He stepped into the presidency one year ago,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: with the country on the brink of hyperinflation,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: deep in debt and suffering

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: for mass unemployment and poverty.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: He took this crisis head-on,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: transforming one of Latin America's largest economies

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: through pure free-market principles.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: In just a few months in office,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: he already achieved Argentina's

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: first fiscal surplus in 16 years,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: and not just avoided the hyperinflation,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: but brought inflation down to its lowest in three years.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: We discuss all of this in detail,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: both the successes and the challenges.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: His depth of knowledge

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: of economic principles, metrics and data

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: was truly impressive and refreshing

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: to hear from a world leader.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: But even bigger than the economic transformation of Argentina,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: Javier represents the universal fight

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: against government corruption and the fight for freedom,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: economic freedom, political freedom and freedom of speech.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: He has many critics,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: many of whom are part of the corrupt establishment

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: he is seeking to dismantle.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: But many are simply Argentinian citizens,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: scared of the pain his radical policies may bring,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: at least in the short term.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: But whether one disagrees with his methods or not,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: no one can deny that his presidency

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: marks one of the most ambitious attempts

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: at economic transformation in modern history,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: and that Javier Malé is truly a force of nature,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: combining the rigor of an economist

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: with the passion of a revolutionary

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: in the fight for freedom of a nation he loves.

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: Argentina is one of my favorite countries,

segments.speaker: S02
segments.text: so I sincerely hope he succeeds.
